headline: Appeal denied: fence at 485 South Union Street must have its finished side facing out.
summary: The owners appealed a city order on their replacement fence. The city said the fence must show its finished side to adjoining properties. The owners said they did not know that rule, and that their neighbors approved the fence.
decisions: Denied the appeal and upheld the city's decision on a fence at 485 South Union Street.
discussion: Fence type and permit: Members debated whether the new fence counts as an in-kind replacement, and several said the permit covers the style that was installed.
Finished side orientation: Members said the ordinance requires the finished side to face out, and that fixing it would mean flipping the panels.

decision_evidence.quote: I move that we uphold the administrative decision and deny the appeal. ... That passes.

decision_titles: Fence appeal at 485 South Union Street
